question:
In the following question, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d8e9b3b6470d08d3acc55a67ccee5502bb8d2f2c5b363e06f4e9393774abc3c.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) Shaded quadrilateral element → Increasing column wise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd81f841a38902ddaf72b39170ee03c228d07afdc566ba5852833e1b2f40f030.png] 

2) Arrow element → Shift one step downward column wise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59a69b0a4de869479b6624cd9a5b2d5701d245eb73779feafa1bdd03b1cc98c3.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37d7869cc2a729b80cf0dc23bf8034cb9ec5f651713e2d75e1886a1ef18978a8.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
